name: Wall-mounted luminaire plan mark
summary: Plan mark for a wall-mounted luminaire, drawn as a luminaire symbol attached to the wall line.
description: Wall lights are drawn with the luminaire mark touching or attached to the wall by a short bar, which distinguishes them from ceiling luminaires. The mounting height is either noted on the symbol or covered by a typical detail.

Wall luminaires are used in corridors, stairwells, bedrooms and external facades. The installer needs the mounting height and the fitting type to set the box before plastering, so this symbol usually carries a height tag. The symbol does not indicate the light distribution (uplight, downlight or both). That comes from the schedule.
distinction: A ceiling luminaire stands free in the room on plan; the wall form is attached to the wall line.
